model.name: The Leap (paper) — election markets adaptation
model.fees: Kalshi official quadratic taker schedule (src/fees.js); M=1 for PRES/CONTROLH/CONTROLS (captured GET /series); 50 SENATE{ST} series fee configs registered from data/kalshi/historical/senate-2024.json
model.ranking: realized P&L at settlement; entrants with fewer than the minimum trading days are unranked (reported with reason)
model.note: NO-side fills are derived reciprocal prices (1 - yesClose) and labeled per fill. No-trade bars are refused.

results.name: FavoriteHold
results.thesis: In the final ~75 days, heavy favorites (p>=0.65) are underpriced: the exchange’s "70% means 70%" calibration claim implies fair pricing, but late news risk should command a premium markets undercharge. Buy the favorite, hold to settlement.
results.unrankedReason: only 1 active trading day(s); The Leap minimum is 3

results.name: LongshotDCA
results.thesis: CONTROL: longshot bias says cheap sides (0.05<=p<=0.20) are OVERpriced, so daily dollar-cost averaging them should LOSE money. If this entrant ends positive, the longshot-bias theory is wrong for these markets.
results.unrankedReason: no qualifying entry ever appeared in the universe (0 trades)

results.name: MomentumChase
results.thesis: In the final months, >=4pp five-day price moves are news-driven and informative: momentum continues. Enter with the move, exit on a 3pp adverse drift from the entry price.

results.name: OverreactionFade
results.thesis: Counter to momentum: >=4pp five-day drops OVERreact to bad news and revert toward the 14-day mean. Fade the drop (buy YES), exit at the 14-day mean or hold to settlement.

results.name: PollVsMarket
results.thesis: The last verified 538 national average (2024-09-12: Harris +2.82pp, i.e. Trump -2.82) implies ~35% for Trump via the logistic mapping (k=4.5, labeled assumption), while Kalshi traded Trump 50-57c. If polls still carry information the market ignores, buy the side cheap relative to the poll until the gap closes to <5pp.
results.unrankedReason: only 1 active trading day(s); The Leap minimum is 3

results.name: LateFavoriteYield
results.thesis: Buy favorites at >=0.90 only in the final 14 days and collect the carry to settlement: last-minute upsets are rare, and a 90c favorite over 14 days has a strong effective annualized return relative to its risk.
results.unrankedReason: no qualifying entry ever appeared in the universe (0 trades)

results.name: VolumeShock
results.thesis: Days where volume is >=3x the 7-day average AND price moves >=4pp contain genuine informed flow. Enter with the shock, hold to settlement (or exit on a 3pp reversal).
results.unrankedReason: only 2 active trading day(s); The Leap minimum is 3

results.name: FinalWeekConsensus
results.thesis: In the last 7 days, the side trading above 0.50 with a 7-day average above 0.52 has a stable edge: the remaining window is too short for shocks. Buy consensus, hold to settlement.
results.unrankedReason: only 1 active trading day(s); The Leap minimum is 3
